selection: first eligible both-open same-side X connectors per seed; hand 4/5; 8 handSize x opponentMinHand x connectorGap quota cells
metricDirection: keep HIGH minus keep LOW = spend LOW minus spend HIGH; positive pips is worse; residual pips subtracts immediate high-low gap
confidence: exploratory position-level normal 95% CI; no multiple-testing adjustment
limitations: assumption-labelled branch opening; deterministic bots; first-eligible/quota selection not population-weighted; block winner unassigned; branch assumptions; selected quota cells; exploratory 95% normal CIs not multiplicity-adjusted; no causal effect of hand pressure.
hypothesis: Does keeping the higher connector have any advantage beyond immediate pip gap, and does nearest opponent hand size <=3 or connector nominal gap alter the result? Independent disjoint seeds 62000+, matched worlds, 3 continuation policies.
finding: Independent holdout; evaluate residual pips and finish effects at position level. Positive keepHighMinusLow.pips is worse; negative residualPips indicates relative downstream advantage after subtracting immediate pip gap. No human recommendation from unadjusted nominal gap.
nextAction: Compare new holdout with 51000..51289 using position-level heterogeneity and independent discovery policies; build direct paired opponent-pressure policy intervention, avoid conditioning on post-action state.
